overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short BE Daily ETF (BEZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% inverse leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Bloom Energy Corp. (BE), net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. BEZ was launched on Feb 10, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
